provenance.note: Krishnagiri district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope krishnagiri-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-krishnagiri). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId): the Thenpennai's to the east, the Cauvery's Chinnar and Dodda Halla to the south-west. The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/krishnagiri-rivers/tnpcb-type-sectors.json.

properties.name: SEWAGE TREATMENT PLANT OF KRISHNAGIRI MUNICIPALITY
properties.note: Units TNGIS matched to a land parcel only; the register is a subset of TNPCB's consent register
properties.status: On the TNPCB register as 'Sewage treatment plant of Krishnagiri Municipality' (Red, Large, consent year 2017, Agasipalli); the municipality's sewerage page says the town has no underground drainage, and a sewer line along NH-48 is being laid (NHAI permission request). Whether the plant operates is not stated by any page read.

properties.name: Hosur Corporation STP, Santhapuram (12.51 MLD, under construction)
properties.status: Under construction: Civil works completed. Decanter erection work completed. Fine and medium screen erection completed. (corporation sheet, 2026-06-17)
properties.scheme: Underground sewerage scheme to Hosur City Municipal Corporation: Rs.582.54 crore sanctioned (RAS G.O.Ms.No. 143 / MA&WS (MA2) / dt: 08.11.2023 for Rs.582.54 crore); Rs.135.81 crore spent (23.31%) as on 2026-06-17; sewage generated 24.727 MLD now, 43.117 MLD by 2054; Package I (zones 1 to 5), collection network 35%; Package II (zones 6 to 11), collection network 35%; Package III, the two treatment plants 63%
properties.fundingAsReported: AMRUT 2.0 with KfW Development Bank finance, on a design, build, operate and transfer basis with ten years' operation (trade press, December 2024 and April 2025)
properties.coverageAsReported: 35 of the corporation's 45 wards, wholly or partly, in this phase; the rest in a second phase (trade press, December 2024)
properties.siteAsPrinted: Santhapuram (trade press); the corporation's sheet prints only the capacity
properties.locationNote: Santhapuram revenue village, Hosur taluk (TNGIS, LGD 933511), centroid
